use express_keywords
use express_structure
use express_remarks
use express_literals
use express_operators

# EXPRESS grammar — PARG edition 2.
#
# The translation of lib/expressir/express/grammar/parser.rb, rule by
# rule; see CONVENTIONS.md for the mapping and the parity-critical
# surfaces. Composition is native PARG: keyword/scalar/operator
# terminals live in their own grammar files, imported by `use` with
# namespaced references.
grammar ExpressSyntax version "0.1.0" edition 2 {

  # match[" \r\n\t\f"].repeat(1)
  trivia = 1*(%x20 / %x0D / %x0A / %x09 / %x0C)

  # The DSL's skip(:trivia, whitespace: :space, exempt: ...) — the
  # exempted rules become `atomic` declarations as they land; the
  # remark rules stay OUT of the skip surface (they are product data).
  skip = trivia

  # Grows as structural bodies land; today: statement = skipStmt.
  stmt = express_structure.skipStmt
  syntax = *stmt

  # --- probe entries (mid-migration; the final entry is `syntax`) ---
  # local aliases over the namespaced imports (entry targets are local)
  embeddedRemark = express_remarks.embeddedRemark
  tailRemark = express_remarks.tailRemark
  simpleId = express_literals.simpleId
  simpleStringLiteral = express_literals.simpleStringLiteral
  digits = (express_literals.digits) as digits
  op_decl = express_operators.op_decl
  op_colon_less_greater_colon = express_operators.op_colon_less_greater_colon
  tSCHEMA = express_keywords.tSCHEMA
  tBASED_ON = express_keywords.tBASED_ON
  tGENERIC_ENTITY = express_keywords.tGENERIC_ENTITY
  tEND_SUBTYPE_CONSTRAINT = express_keywords.tEND_SUBTYPE_CONSTRAINT
